evidence: Implements core changes in src/common/setting.h, src/common/setting_internal.h, and src/common/args.cpp.
rationale: Introduces compile-time type safety and centralized definitions for configuration settings across the entire codebase. Replacing stringly-typed argument registration and lookups with typed `common::Setting` declarations removes recurring hazards around name typos, type mismatches, and default drift, while unblocking type and range checking (#22978).
